# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Personality

Blewett is known as a relentless and demanding worker who drives others hard. According to former servant girls, she possesses a fierce temper and is notoriously stingy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## History

Blewett offered to take in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrived at Mrs. Spencer's house to address the orphan child mix-up. However, her harsh demeanor distressed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and caused [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate. Ultimately, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decided against leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her and chose to take the girl back home instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P1](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P2](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VI.
